# 3. Plotting panel 3D

```{r}
# ── Highlight barcodes: PT17 cells carrying BRAF_G466A_Het ───────────────────
highlight_barcodes <- rownames(
    combined_dna_pro@meta.data %>%
        filter(Donor == 'PT17') %>%
        filter(Clone == 'BRAF_G466A_Het')
)

cat("Highlighted cells:", length(highlight_barcodes), "\n")

library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(combined_dna_pro, "umap"))

umap_df$barcode <- rownames(umap_df)
umap_df$Highlighted <- umap_df$barcode %in% highlight_barcodes

stopifnot(sum(umap_df$Highlighted) == length(highlight_barcodes))   # every barcode matched a UMAP row

# Split into two layers so highlighted cells are guaranteed on top regardless
# of row order — a single shuffled layer can't promise that.
df_bg <- umap_df[!umap_df$Highlighted, , drop = FALSE]
df_fg <- umap_df[ umap_df$Highlighted, , drop = FALSE]

# Single highlight colour (Erythroblast's colour, reused here as a plain
# highlight colour, not a cell-type mapping) with a DARKENED outline —
# darken, not lighten, so the highlighted points' edges stay visible
# against each other and against the grey background, matching the
# contrast fix used in the other UMAP scripts.
highlight_fill  <- "#8CD17D"
highlight_color <- darken(highlight_fill, amount = 0.5)

# Background: uniform grey fill AND grey outline — kept visually flat/
# neutral so it reads purely as context. No stroke on the background at
# all (stroke = 0), so only highlighted cells carry a visible outline.
bg_fill  <- "grey85"
bg_color <- "grey85"   # same as fill => effectively no visible outline

p <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
    # Background: all non-highlighted cells, small, flat grey, no stroke.
    geom_point(
        data   = df_bg,
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 2,
        stroke = 0,
        alpha  = 0.6,
        fill   = bg_fill,
        color  = bg_color
    ) +
    # Foreground: highlighted cells only, larger, single distinct colour,
    # with a real stroke (only these get an outline at all).
    geom_point(
        data   = df_fg,
        shape  = 21,
        size   = 4,
        stroke = 0.6,
        alpha  = 0.95,
        fill   = highlight_fill,
        color  = highlight_color
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )

save_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures"
dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_3D.pdf"),
    plot = p, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(save_dir, "Fig_3D.png"),
    plot = p, width = 5.5, height = 5, dpi = 300)

# 83% plasma cells
```

# 5. Additional figures: every clone / mutation / CNV for every patient

Highlighted cells coloured by cell type, with a proportion barplot underneath. UMAP panel fixed to the Fig_3D / Fig_S7 size.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# ── Settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
celltype_col <- "Celltype_revised_refined"   # <-- cell type annotation column
donor_col    <- "Donor"
clone_col    <- "Clone"
min_cells    <- 5                             # skip groups with fewer highlighted cells

base_dir <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures/Additional"
dirs <- list(
    Clone    = file.path(base_dir, "Clones"),
    Mutation = file.path(base_dir, "Mutations"),
    CNV      = file.path(base_dir, "CNVs")
)
invisible(lapply(dirs, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))

# Values treated as "not altered" (never highlighted). Check the tables printed
# below and edit these if your encoding differs.
mut_ref <- c("WT", "0", "Missing", "3", "Unknown", "")   # covers text calls and Mosaic NGT (0=WT, 3=missing)
cnv_ref <- c("Neutral", "Normal", "Diploid", "WT", "None", "No", "Missing", "")

# Fixed panel geometry: UMAP panel = exactly the panel of Fig_3D / Fig_S7
# (5.5 x 5 in page minus 10 pt margins), fixed in inches so titles/legends
# can never shrink it. Page size is computed from the assembled plot.
umap_panel_w <- 5.5 - 20 / 72.27
umap_panel_h <- 5.0 - 20 / 72.27
bar_h_in     <- 0.4

save_fixed <- function(p, fname, pad = 0.1) {
    g <- patchwork::patchworkGrob(p)
    grDevices::pdf(NULL)
    w <- grid::convertWidth (sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
    h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
    grDevices::dev.off()
    ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = w, height = h, limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(paste0(fname, ".png"), plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
}

color_map <- c(
    "B cell"          = "#B07AA1",
    "Plasma cell"     = "#8CD17D",
    "CD14+ monocyte"  = "#F28E2B",
    "CD16+ monocyte"  = "#FFBE7D",
    "Mono/Macrophage" = "#5A5A5A",
    "CD4+ T cell"     = "#9D7660",
    "CD8+ T cell"     = "#514DAD",
    "cDC"             = "#F1CE63",
    "pDC"             = "#86BCB6",
    "NK cell"         = "#FABFD2",
    "Erythroblast"    = "#E15759",
    "HSPC"            = "#4E79A7",
    "Other T cell"    = "#BAB0AC"
)
outline_map <- setNames(darken(color_map, amount = 0.5), names(color_map))

meta <- combined_dna_pro@meta.data
stopifnot(all(c(celltype_col, donor_col, clone_col) %in% colnames(meta)))

missing_ct <- setdiff(unique(as.character(meta[[celltype_col]])), names(color_map))
if (length(missing_ct)) warning("Cell types without a colour: ", paste(missing_ct, collapse = ", "))

# ── Feature columns ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mut_cols <- grep("^[A-Za-z0-9]+_c\\.", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)    # e.g. TP53_c.524G>A_R175H_...
cnv_cols <- grep("^chr[0-9XY]+[pq]?$", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)    # chr3, chr5q, chr17p, ...
cat("Mutation columns:", length(mut_cols), " | CNV columns:", length(cnv_cols), "\n")

cat("\nMutation call values (all columns pooled):\n")
print(table(unlist(lapply(meta[mut_cols], as.character)), useNA = "ifany"))
cat("\nCNV call values (all columns pooled):\n")
print(table(unlist(lapply(meta[cnv_cols], as.character)), useNA = "ifany"))

# "TP53_c.524G>A_R175H_7578406_C_T" -> "TP53_R175H" (falls back to cDNA if protein is NA)
short_mut <- function(x) {
    p <- strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    paste(p[1], ifelse(p[3] == "NA", p[2], p[3]), sep = "_")
}
safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

# ── Shared UMAP data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(combined_dna_pro, "umap"))
umap_df$barcode  <- rownames(umap_df)
umap_df$CellType <- as.character(meta[umap_df$barcode, celltype_col])
umap_df$Donor    <- as.character(meta[umap_df$barcode, donor_col])
umap_df$Clone    <- as.character(meta[umap_df$barcode, clone_col])

donors <- sort(unique(na.omit(umap_df$Donor)))

# ── Plot helper: UMAP highlight + proportion bar ─────────────────────────────
plot_highlight <- function(is_hl, title, out_base) {
    is_hl[is.na(is_hl)] <- FALSE
    df_bg <- umap_df[!is_hl, , drop = FALSE]
    df_fg <- umap_df[ is_hl, , drop = FALSE]

    comp <- df_fg %>%
        count(CellType, name = "n") %>%
        mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n), total = sum(n)) %>%   # exact, so stacks sum to 100
        arrange(desc(n))
    top <- comp[1, ]

    df_fg   <- df_fg[sample(nrow(df_fg)), , drop = FALSE]
    present <- intersect(names(color_map), unique(df_fg$CellType))

    p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
        geom_point(
            data = df_bg, shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.6,
            fill = "grey85", color = "grey85"
        ) +
        geom_point(
            data = df_fg, aes(fill = CellType, color = CellType),
            shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.95
        ) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, breaks = present, name = NULL, na.value = "grey50") +
        scale_color_manual(values = outline_map, breaks = present, name = NULL, na.value = "grey30") +
        guides(color = "none",
               fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
        labs(
            title    = title,
            subtitle = sprintf("n = %d cells; %.0f%% %s", top$total, top$pct, top$CellType)
        ) +
        theme_void(base_size = 12) +
        theme(
            plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
            legend.position = "right",
            plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
        )

    bar_df <- comp %>%
        mutate(CellType = factor(CellType, levels = rev(comp$CellType)),
               label = ifelse(pct >= 5, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""))

    p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = pct, y = "", fill = CellType)) +
        geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
        geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.value = "grey50", guide = "none") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                           labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), clip = "off") +   # zoom, never drop segments
        labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
        theme(
            panel.grid   = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
            plot.margin  = margin(0, 10, 10, 10)
        )

    p <- p_umap / p_bar +
        plot_layout(
            widths  = unit(umap_panel_w, "in"),
            heights = unit(c(umap_panel_h, bar_h_in), "in")
        )

    save_fixed(p, out_base)

    comp
}

# Loop driver for per-donor categorical features (mutations / CNVs)
run_feature <- function(cols, ref_vals, label_fun, type, out_dir) {
    res <- list()
    for (fc in cols) {
        vals  <- as.character(meta[umap_df$barcode, fc])
        fname <- label_fun(fc)
        for (d in donors) {
            in_d   <- umap_df$Donor == d & !is.na(umap_df$Donor)
            states <- setdiff(unique(vals[in_d]), c(ref_vals, NA))
            for (s in states) {
                is_hl <- in_d & vals == s
                if (sum(is_hl, na.rm = TRUE) < min_cells) next
                title <- paste0(d, " — ", fname, " (", s, ")")
                comp  <- plot_highlight(
                    is_hl, title,
                    file.path(out_dir, paste0(safe_name(d), "__", safe_name(fname), "__", safe_name(s)))
                )
                res[[length(res) + 1]] <- mutate(comp, Type = type, Donor = d,
                                                 Feature = fname, State = s)
                cat(sprintf("%s | %s | %s (%s): n=%d\n", type, d, fname, s, comp$total[1]))
            }
        }
    }
    bind_rows(res)
}
```

## - Clones

```{r}
combos <- umap_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Donor), !is.na(Clone), Clone != "") %>%
    distinct(Donor, Clone) %>%
    arrange(Donor, Clone)

clone_res <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
    d <- combos$Donor[i]; cl <- combos$Clone[i]
    is_hl <- umap_df$Donor == d & umap_df$Clone == cl
    if (sum(is_hl, na.rm = TRUE) < min_cells) next
    comp <- plot_highlight(
        is_hl, paste0(d, " — ", cl),
        file.path(dirs$Clone, paste0(safe_name(d), "__", safe_name(cl)))
    )
    clone_res[[length(clone_res) + 1]] <- mutate(comp, Type = "Clone", Donor = d,
                                                 Feature = cl, State = NA_character_)
    cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] Clone | %s | %s : n=%d\n", i, nrow(combos), d, cl, comp$total[1]))
}
clone_res <- bind_rows(clone_res)
```

## - Mutations

```{r}
mut_res <- run_feature(mut_cols, mut_ref, short_mut, "Mutation", dirs$Mutation)
```

## - CNVs

```{r}
cnv_res <- run_feature(cnv_cols, cnv_ref, identity, "CNV", dirs$CNV)
```

## - Composition table

```{r}
composition_df <- bind_rows(clone_res, mut_res, cnv_res) %>%
    mutate(pct = round(pct, 1)) %>%
    select(Type, Donor, Feature, State, total, CellType, n, pct)
write.csv(composition_df, file.path(base_dir, "celltype_composition_all.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```


# 6. Reviewer Q13 — lineage distribution of non-TP53 vs TP53 mutant cells

Per patient: UMAP highlighting WT / non-TP53 mutant / TP53 mutant cells, with stacked cell-type proportions for each group underneath. Run twice: (a) non-TP53 mutant pooled; (b) non-TP53 mutant split into DTA (DNMT3A/TET2/ASXL1) vs other non-TP53.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)

# ── Settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
celltype_col <- "Celltype_revised_refined"   # <-- cell type annotation column
donor_col    <- "Donor"
min_cells    <- 5          # a mutation counts for a donor only if >= this many mutant cells;
                           # groups below this are not tested / donors not plotted
mut_vals     <- c("1", "2")   # Mosaic NGT: 1 = Het, 2 = Hom
wt_val       <- "0"           # Mosaic NGT: 0 = WT (3 = missing)
dta_genes    <- c("DNMT3A", "TET2", "ASXL1")

base_out <- "/project/meadlab/shared/02__Projects/02b__Tapestri/results/figures/Additional/Q13_TP53_vs_nonTP53"

# ── Fixed panel geometry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UMAP panel = exactly the panel of Fig_3D / Fig_S7 (5.5 x 5 in page minus
# 10 pt margins each side), fixed in inches so titles, legends and bars can
# never shrink it. The page size is computed from the assembled plot.
umap_panel_w <- 5.5 - 20 / 72.27
umap_panel_h <- 5.0 - 20 / 72.27
bar_h_per    <- 0.4            # inches per bar row

color_map <- c(
    "B cell"          = "#B07AA1",
    "Plasma cell"     = "#8CD17D",
    "CD14+ monocyte"  = "#F28E2B",
    "CD16+ monocyte"  = "#FFBE7D",
    "Mono/Macrophage" = "#5A5A5A",
    "CD4+ T cell"     = "#9D7660",
    "CD8+ T cell"     = "#514DAD",
    "cDC"             = "#F1CE63",
    "pDC"             = "#86BCB6",
    "NK cell"         = "#FABFD2",
    "Erythroblast"    = "#E15759",
    "HSPC"            = "#4E79A7",
    "Other T cell"    = "#BAB0AC"
)

grp_fill_all <- c(
    "WT"                    = "#4D4D4D",
    "Non-TP53 mutant"       = "#E69F00",
    "DTA mutant"            = "#E69F00",
    "Other non-TP53 mutant" = "#0072B2",
    "TP53 mutant"           = "#C2185B"
)
grp_short <- c(
    "WT" = "WT", "Non-TP53 mutant" = "Non-TP53", "DTA mutant" = "DTA",
    "Other non-TP53 mutant" = "Other", "TP53 mutant" = "TP53"
)

meta <- combined_dna_pro@meta.data
stopifnot(all(c(celltype_col, donor_col) %in% colnames(meta)))

missing_ct <- setdiff(unique(as.character(meta[[celltype_col]])), names(color_map))
if (length(missing_ct)) warning("Cell types without a colour: ", paste(missing_ct, collapse = ", "))

# ── Genotype matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mut_cols    <- grep("^[A-Za-z0-9]+_c\\.", colnames(meta), value = TRUE)
gene_of     <- sub("_.*", "", mut_cols)
tp53_cols   <- mut_cols[gene_of == "TP53"]
dta_cols    <- mut_cols[gene_of %in% dta_genes]
nondta_cols <- mut_cols[!(gene_of %in% c("TP53", dta_genes))]

G <- sapply(meta[mut_cols], as.character)
rownames(G) <- rownames(meta)

short_mut <- function(x) {
    p <- strsplit(x, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    paste(p[1], ifelse(p[3] == "NA", p[2], p[3]), sep = "_")
}
safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)

# Row-wise helpers that also work with zero columns
any_mut <- function(M) rowSums(array(M %in% mut_vals, dim = dim(M))) > 0
all_wt  <- function(M) rowSums(array(M == wt_val,     dim = dim(M))) == ncol(M)

# Save with the page sized to the content (panels are fixed in inches)
save_fixed <- function(p, fname, pad = 0.1) {
    g <- patchwork::patchworkGrob(p)
    grDevices::pdf(NULL)
    w <- grid::convertWidth (sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
    h <- grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE) + pad
    grDevices::dev.off()
    ggsave(paste0(fname, ".pdf"), plot = p, width = w, height = h, limitsize = FALSE)
    ggsave(paste0(fname, ".png"), plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
}

umap_base <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(combined_dna_pro, "umap"))
umap_base$barcode  <- rownames(umap_base)
umap_base$CellType <- as.character(meta[umap_base$barcode, celltype_col])
umap_base$Donor    <- as.character(meta[umap_base$barcode, donor_col])
```

## - Main function

```{r}
# Group definitions (per donor, using only variants with >= min_cells mutant cells in that donor):
#   TP53 mutant           : Het/Hom for any TP53 variant
#   Non-TP53 mutant       : WT at all TP53 variants AND mutant for >= 1 non-TP53 variant      (split_dta = FALSE)
#   Other non-TP53 mutant : WT at all TP53 variants AND mutant for >= 1 non-DTA, non-TP53 var (split_dta = TRUE)
#   DTA mutant            : WT at all TP53 variants, mutant for >= 1 DTA variant, no other    (split_dta = TRUE)
#                           (cells carrying DTA + another non-TP53 variant go to "Other",
#                            as DTA is usually the ancestral hit)
#   WT                    : WT at every variant
#   Missing calls otherwise -> unassigned, drawn as background.
run_q13 <- function(split_dta) {

    out_dir <- file.path(base_out, ifelse(split_dta, "split_DTA", "pooled"))
    dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

    grp_levels <- if (split_dta) {
        c("WT", "DTA mutant", "Other non-TP53 mutant", "TP53 mutant")
    } else {
        c("WT", "Non-TP53 mutant", "TP53 mutant")
    }
    non_tp53_grps <- setdiff(grp_levels, c("WT", "TP53 mutant"))
    grp_fill <- grp_fill_all[grp_levels]
    grp_line <- setNames(darken(grp_fill, amount = 0.5), names(grp_fill))

    bar_h_in <- bar_h_per * length(grp_levels)

    # ── Assign groups ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    group_vec  <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, nrow(meta)), rownames(meta))
    donor_info <- list()

    for (d in sort(unique(na.omit(meta[[donor_col]])))) {
        cells <- rownames(meta)[meta[[donor_col]] == d & !is.na(meta[[donor_col]])]
        Gd    <- G[cells, , drop = FALSE]

        n_mut    <- colSums(array(Gd %in% mut_vals, dim = dim(Gd)))
        relevant <- mut_cols[n_mut >= min_cells]
        rel_tp53 <- intersect(relevant, tp53_cols)
        rel_dta  <- intersect(relevant, dta_cols)
        rel_nd   <- intersect(relevant, nondta_cols)
        if (length(c(rel_dta, rel_nd)) == 0) next

        tp53_mut <- any_mut(Gd[, rel_tp53, drop = FALSE])
        tp53_wt  <- all_wt (Gd[, rel_tp53, drop = FALSE])
        dta_mut  <- any_mut(Gd[, rel_dta,  drop = FALSE])
        nd_mut   <- any_mut(Gd[, rel_nd,   drop = FALSE])
        all_ok   <- all_wt (Gd[, relevant, drop = FALSE])

        grp <- rep(NA_character_, length(cells))
        grp[all_ok] <- "WT"
        if (split_dta) {
            grp[tp53_wt & dta_mut & !nd_mut] <- "DTA mutant"
            grp[tp53_wt & nd_mut]            <- "Other non-TP53 mutant"
        } else {
            grp[tp53_wt & (dta_mut | nd_mut)] <- "Non-TP53 mutant"
        }
        grp[tp53_mut] <- "TP53 mutant"
        group_vec[cells] <- grp

        donor_info[[d]] <- list(
            tp53  = sapply(rel_tp53, short_mut, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
            dta   = sapply(rel_dta,  short_mut, USE.NAMES = FALSE),
            other = sapply(rel_nd,   short_mut, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        )
    }

    umap_df <- umap_base
    umap_df$Group <- factor(group_vec[umap_df$barcode], levels = grp_levels)

    donors_plot <- umap_df %>%
        filter(Group %in% non_tp53_grps) %>%
        count(Donor) %>%
        filter(n >= min_cells) %>%
        pull(Donor)
    cat(ifelse(split_dta, "[split DTA]", "[pooled]"),
        "Donors with non-TP53 mutant cells outside TP53 clones:",
        paste(donors_plot, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    comp_all  <- list()
    stats_all <- list()

    # ── Per-patient figures + one figure pooling all plotted patients ────────
    pooled_lab <- "All patients"
    for (d in c(donors_plot, pooled_lab)) {
        is_pooled <- d == pooled_lab
        df_d <- if (is_pooled) {
            umap_df %>% filter(Donor %in% donors_plot, !is.na(Group))
        } else {
            umap_df %>% filter(Donor == d, !is.na(Group))
        }
        df_bg <- umap_df %>% filter(!(barcode %in% df_d$barcode))
        df_fg <- df_d %>% arrange(Group)          # WT first, TP53 mutant drawn on top

        # Exact (unrounded) percentages so stacks sum to exactly 100
        comp <- df_d %>%
            count(Group, CellType, name = "n") %>%
            group_by(Group) %>%
            mutate(total = sum(n), pct = 100 * n / total) %>%
            ungroup() %>%
            mutate(Donor = d)
        comp_all[[d]] <- comp

        n_by <- table(df_d$Group)

        # Each non-TP53 group vs TP53 mutant: lineage distribution test
        p_vals <- sapply(non_tp53_grps, function(g) {
            if (n_by[[g]] < min_cells || n_by[["TP53 mutant"]] < min_cells) return(NA_real_)
            sub <- df_d %>% filter(Group %in% c(g, "TP53 mutant"))
            tab <- table(droplevels(sub$Group), sub$CellType)
            suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e4)$p.value)
        })

        stats_all[[d]] <- data.frame(
            Donor            = d,
            TP53_variants    = paste(donor_info[[d]]$tp53,  collapse = "; "),
            DTA_variants     = paste(donor_info[[d]]$dta,   collapse = "; "),
            other_variants   = paste(donor_info[[d]]$other, collapse = "; "),
            t(setNames(as.integer(n_by[grp_levels]), paste0("n_", grp_short[grp_levels]))),
            t(setNames(p_vals, paste0("p_", grp_short[non_tp53_grps], "_vs_TP53"))),
            check.names = FALSE
        )

        grp_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (n=%d)", grp_levels, as.integer(n_by[grp_levels])), grp_levels)

        p_txt <- paste(
            sprintf("%s vs TP53: %s", grp_short[non_tp53_grps],
                    ifelse(is.na(p_vals), "n.t.", sprintf("p = %.3g", p_vals))),
            collapse = "; "
        )
        var_txt <- if (is_pooled) {
            sprintf("Cells pooled across %d patients: %s", length(donors_plot), paste(donors_plot, collapse = ", "))
        } else if (split_dta) {
            sprintf("DTA: %s | Other: %s",
                    ifelse(length(donor_info[[d]]$dta),   paste(donor_info[[d]]$dta,   collapse = ", "), "none"),
                    ifelse(length(donor_info[[d]]$other), paste(donor_info[[d]]$other, collapse = ", "), "none"))
        } else {
            paste("Non-TP53:", paste(c(donor_info[[d]]$dta, donor_info[[d]]$other), collapse = ", "))
        }

        # UMAP
        p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
            geom_point(data = df_bg, shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.6,
                       fill = "grey85", color = "grey85") +
            geom_point(data = df_fg, aes(fill = Group, color = Group),
                       shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.95) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = grp_fill, labels = grp_lab, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
            scale_color_manual(values = grp_line, guide = "none") +
            guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
            labs(title = d, subtitle = paste0(var_txt, "\nLineage \u03c7\u00b2 — ", p_txt)) +
            theme_void(base_size = 12) +
            theme(
                plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
                plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
                legend.position = "right",
                plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
            )

        # Stacked proportion bars (one per group)
        bar_df <- comp %>%
            mutate(Group    = factor(Group, levels = rev(grp_levels)),
                   CellType = factor(CellType, levels = names(color_map)),
                   label    = ifelse(pct >= 8, paste0(round(pct), "%"), ""))
        present <- intersect(names(color_map), unique(as.character(bar_df$CellType)))

        p_bar <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = pct, y = Group, fill = CellType)) +
            geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
            geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, breaks = present, name = NULL, na.value = "grey50") +
            scale_y_discrete(labels = grp_lab, drop = FALSE) +
            scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                               labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
            coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), clip = "off") +   # zoom, never drop segments
            labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
            guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)) +
            theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
            theme(
                panel.grid   = element_blank(),
                axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                legend.position = "bottom",
                legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
                legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
                plot.margin  = margin(0, 10, 10, 10)
            )

        p <- p_umap / p_bar +
            plot_layout(
                widths  = unit(umap_panel_w, "in"),
                heights = unit(c(umap_panel_h, bar_h_in), "in")
            )

        # Pooled figure: one UMAP per group side by side (no overplotting
        # between groups), each with its own proportion bar underneath.
        if (is_pooled) {
            grps_here <- grp_levels[as.integer(n_by[grp_levels]) > 0]

            umaps <- lapply(grps_here, function(g) {
                fg <- df_d %>% filter(Group == g)
                fg <- fg[sample(nrow(fg)), , drop = FALSE]
                bg <- umap_df %>% filter(!(barcode %in% fg$barcode))
                ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2)) +
                    geom_point(data = bg, shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0, alpha = 0.6,
                               fill = "grey85", color = "grey85") +
                    geom_point(data = fg, shape = 21, size = 4, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.95,
                               fill = grp_fill[[g]], color = grp_line[[g]]) +
                    labs(title = grp_lab[[g]]) +
                    theme_void(base_size = 12) +
                    theme(
                        plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
                        plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
                    )
            })

            bars <- lapply(grps_here, function(g) {
                bd <- bar_df %>% filter(Group == g)
                ggplot(bd, aes(x = pct, y = "", fill = CellType)) +
                    geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
                    geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 2.6) +
                    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, breaks = present, name = NULL,
                                      na.value = "grey50", drop = FALSE) +
                    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
                                       labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
                    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 100), clip = "off") +
                    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
                    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
                    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
                    theme(
                        panel.grid   = element_blank(),
                        axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
                        axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0.3),
                        legend.key.size = unit(0.35, "cm"),
                        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
                        plot.margin  = margin(0, 10, 10, 10)
                    )
            })

            k <- length(grps_here)
            p <- wrap_plots(c(umaps, bars), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE) +
                plot_layout(
                    widths  = unit(rep(umap_panel_w, k), "in"),
                    heights = unit(c(umap_panel_h, bar_h_per), "in"),
                    guides  = "collect"
                ) +
                plot_annotation(
                    title    = d,
                    subtitle = paste0(var_txt, "\nLineage \u03c7\u00b2 — ", p_txt),
                    theme    = theme(
                        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
                        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
                    )
                ) &
                theme(legend.position = "bottom")
        }

        fname <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(safe_name(d), ifelse(split_dta, "__WT_DTA_Other_TP53", "__WT_nonTP53_TP53")))
        save_fixed(p, fname)

        cat(sprintf("  %s: %s | %s\n", d,
                    paste(sprintf("%s=%d", grp_short[grp_levels], as.integer(n_by[grp_levels])), collapse = ", "),
                    p_txt))
    }

    # ── Cohort summary + tables ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    comp_df  <- bind_rows(comp_all)
    stats_df <- bind_rows(stats_all)

    write.csv(comp_df %>% mutate(pct = round(pct, 1)) %>% select(Donor, Group, total, CellType, n, pct),
              file.path(out_dir, "Q13_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(stats_df, file.path(out_dir, "Q13_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

    sum_df <- comp_df %>%
        mutate(Donor    = factor(Donor, levels = c(donors_plot, pooled_lab)),
               Group    = factor(Group, levels = grp_levels),
               CellType = factor(CellType, levels = names(color_map)))

    p_sum <- ggplot(sum_df, aes(x = Group, y = pct, fill = CellType)) +
        geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
        facet_wrap(~ Donor, nrow = 1) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, name = NULL, na.value = "grey50") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = grp_short, drop = FALSE) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells (%)") +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
        theme(
            panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
        )

    w_sum <- 2 + (0.45 * length(grp_levels) + 0.2) * (length(donors_plot) + 1)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Q13_summary.pdf"), p_sum, width = w_sum, height = 4.5)
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Q13_summary.png"), p_sum, width = w_sum, height = 4.5, dpi = 300)

    stats_df
}
```

## - (a) Pooled non-TP53

```{r}
stats_pooled <- run_q13(split_dta = FALSE)
stats_pooled
```

```{r}
stats_split <- run_q13(split_dta = TRUE)
stats_split
```
